refuted_findings.rule: The subagent escape hatch has a cost ceiling [measured]
refuted_findings.target_quote: keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds surface nothing new — dedup against everything seen, not just what's kept
refuted_findings.issue: This is data-driven fan-out (the number of rounds depends on what keeps turning up) with no stated hard cap on total rounds or total agents — only a dryness-based stopping condition. The doctrine requires every data-driven fan-out to be hard-capped, since a dryness condition alone can be satisfied slowly, letting the dispatch meant to buy legwork buy runaway spend instead.
refuted_findings.proposed_fix: Add an explicit ceiling, e.g. 'keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds surface nothing new, hard-capped at N total rounds regardless of dryness.'
